theorem exercise_1_26
  (f F₁ F₂ : ℂ → ℂ) (Ω : Set ℂ) (h1 : IsOpen Ω) (h2 : IsConnected Ω)
  (hF₁ : DifferentiableOn ℂ F₁ Ω) (hF₂ : DifferentiableOn ℂ F₂ Ω)
  (hdF₁ : ∀ x ∈ Ω, deriv F₁ x = f x) (hdF₂ : ∀ x ∈ Ω, deriv F₂ x = f x)
  : ∃ c : ℂ, ∀ x, F₁ x = F₂ x + c:= sorry

It formalises the following claim: Suppose $f$ is continuous in a region $\Omega$. Prove that any two primitives of $f$ (if they exist) differ by a constant.
